howItWorks.title: How authentication works
howItWorks.description: A clear path from image submission to an actionable result.

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: Capture guided photos of the lateral, medial, heel, toe box, outsole, insole, size tag, and box label through the app or API.

steps.title: Standardise
steps.description: Pose estimation and OpenCV-based normalisation bring each image to a consistent angle and scale.

steps.title: Analyse
steps.description: We analyse colour, texture, and shape ratio, then use OCR to check barcodes, QR codes, and typography on tags and labels.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: Signals combine into a confidence score with a verification breakdown. Below-threshold cases go to human review, never a forced verdict.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: The result is returned to your dashboard or via REST API, with its ID stored against the transaction.

testimonials.title: What our partners say
testimonials.description: Marketplace operators on moving authentication from a fixed cost to infrastructure

items.quote: Authentication was our biggest fixed cost and our slowest step. With SneakersLite we moved to pay-per-result, kept a human-review path for the hard cases, and watched the review rate fall month on month. Buyers never see any of that — they just see that the item arrived verified.

We needed coverage that could keep pace with a growing catalogue without adding headcount. SneakersLite gave us model-level coverage, a clear confidence score on every result, and a review path for the edge cases. Integration took days, not months.
